about.heading: Hello!
about.bio: I'm a backend software engineer based in Mumbai, India, building and shipping production systems across the Python ecosystem, from high-concurrency AsyncIO pipelines to AI/LLM-powered microservices.
more: At Homeville Group I work on AI microservices, LLM integration and Python ecosystem projects under the VP of Technology, rebuilding loan processing pipelines, shipping Tier-1 bank integrations, and modernizing OCR and reconciliation systems.
My work was recognized at the Global Fintech Festival 2025.

skills.heading: My Skillset
skills.description: The languages, frameworks, and infrastructure I work with in production.

projectsSection.heading: Work that speaks for itself
projectsSection.description: Projects built end to end, from architecture to shipped binaries.

projects.title: TypeRush
bullets: Built a cross-platform terminal typing trainer in Rust with live WPM and accuracy tracking across 5 modes.
Added a themeable TUI with a configurable settings system and persistent session history across runs.
Developed end to end with AI-assisted coding in Claude Code, shipping CI-built binaries for Linux, macOS, and Windows.

projects.title: 1Link: Modular Link Aggregator
bullets: Architected a modular Django monorepo with 7 decoupled apps for independent scaling.
Exposed a RESTful API layer with DRF serializers, user registration, and dynamic profile URL routing.
Integrated PostgreSQL for relational storage, Redis powering the leaderboard, and Celery for async background jobs.

experienceSection.heading: Experience
experienceSection.description: Where I've built and shipped real production systems.

experience.subtitle: AI microservices, LLM integration and Python ecosystem projects under the VP of Technology
bullets: Rebuilt a loan processing pipeline that crashed past 300 concurrent loans into one stably handling 6,000+ with AsyncIO.
Cut batch runtime 95% from over 30 minutes to under 2 minutes across around 800K rows per run.
Eliminated a MySQL query bottleneck, cutting query latency from 80 seconds to 7 seconds at high concurrency.
Spearheaded the end-to-end build of a FastAPI speech-to-text and translation service with Gemini API summaries.
Benchmarked open-source and cloud transcription models and selected Fast Whisper for production.
Evaluated multi-cloud storage and compute economics across AWS S3 and GCP GCS for cross-cloud egress and migration.
Built and shipped 2 Tier-1 bank integrations end to end with idempotent data contracts for critical transactions.
Developed CRON-driven async workers for event-driven automation, anomaly detection, and reporting.
Automated conversion of production data into masked dummy datasets, replacing manual test data creation.
Built post-deployment validation scripts comparing old and new outputs, saving a day of manual cross-checks per release.
Migrated the multi-tenant reconciliation engine to Python, aligning it with the core backend stack.
Modernized the OCR pipeline with upgraded text extraction, image transformation, and PII masking for image and PDF.

experience.subtitle: Client projects on Linux production infrastructure
bullets: Built and maintained deployment pipelines for 16+ production client environments on Linux infrastructure.
Delivered new client projects from scratch and updated existing ones to meet evolving client requirements.
Handled production troubleshooting, server configuration, system updates, and security across client environments.

experience.subtitle: Training internship, basic Python to advanced Django across multiple modules
bullets: Built RESTful APIs with Django REST Framework and token-based authentication.
Modeled data with Django ORM and managed it through customized Django Admin.
Built NumPy and Pandas pipelines to clean raw datasets and render Chart.js visualizations.
